observations.text:
GOD EXISTS · TRENT HORN
"there must be a reality that is necessary"

Horn reaches this conclusion after invoking sufficient reason, cosmic contingency, and the inability of an infinite contingent series to explain itself.

"

CLASSICAL THEISM IS NOT ESTABLISHED · RAPHAEL LATASTER
"when you argue for supernaturalism you don't automatically get to theism"

Lataster closes by clarifying that his supernaturalism and monotheism grants were conditional discussion concessions rather than beliefs, then argues that generic supernatural evidence still requires comparison before it can establish classical theism.
